criterion_fired: CRITERION 2 (Carry-forward regression) and CRITERION 4 (Next steps specificity)
suggested_change: CRITERION 2 should clarify: 'Score must not decrease from prior call unless the current call contains explicit contradictory evidence (not mere absence of reinforcement). Document carry-forward decisions with 'No new X in this call — maintaining prior score based on [specific prior evidence].' CRITERION 4 should require: 'Next steps must name the stakeholder, specify the verb (Ask/Confirm/Schedule), include a deadline, and state the exact question or confirmation needed.'
